terminals.name: dev
terminals.description: Next.js dev server for Avi Builder on port 3002. Open http://localhost:3002/projects (dashboard) or http://localhost:3002/ycode (editor). AVI_BUILDER_HOSTNAME=localhost lets the builder routes resolve locally instead of redirecting to the production hostname. Add SUPABASE_* secrets in the Secrets panel to enable database-backed features; without them the app runs in its first-run setup state.
